linearize_isotropic_depth_prior: linearize an isotropic depth prior by computing residuals, gradients, and Hessian blocks for depth optimization
linearize_sparse_depth_prior: linearize a sparse depth prior using Cholesky factor L_mm to compute Jacobian and Hessian blocks
construct_sparse_depth_prior_system: construct a sparse depth prior system by accumulating gradients and Hessian blocks into optimization variables
construct_sparse_depth_prior_system_batc: construct a batched sparse depth prior system by accumulating gradients and Hessians across all batches
linearize_mean_depth_prior_system: linearize a mean depth prior system by computing Jacobians and Hessian blocks from kernel matrices
